items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Well we were all three with Jimmy Dorsey. And I think the bassist Johnny Frigo, I think got us, that we could play in a certain room

ctx.x: Tell me a little bit about how the Soft Winds Trio came together.

Well we were all three with Jimmy Dorsey. And I think the bassist Johnny Frigo, I think got us, that we could play in a certain room, I think it was in Detroit. So we loved Jimmy Dorsey’s orchestra and Jimmy Dorsey. So we drew straws to see who had to tell him we were leaving. And Johnny Frigo, the bassist lost. He had to tell him. And Jimmy was very upset needless to say. And the guitar book, I had a lot of ensemble with the horns written. And some of it was pretty difficult. So Jimmy just negated that and got a…
I see. It’d be hard to replace that kind of player.
